description: Proposed engineering student project queries for human approval; this file contains no candidate records or relevance labels.

queries.query: Build a low-cost system that combines vibration and temperature sensors to identify early signs of failure in small factory motors and notify maintenance staff.
Develop a network of low-power pressure and flow sensors that can detect likely leaks in a campus water pipeline and help staff locate the affected section.
Create a phone-based tool that identifies potholes and surface cracks from street images and records approximate locations for a municipal repair team.
Design an assistive mobile system that reads campus signs aloud, supports multiple local languages, and remains usable for people with limited connectivity.
Build a privacy-conscious network monitoring tool for a small laboratory that flags unusual device traffic and explains which observable traffic patterns triggered an alert.
Prototype a small indoor robot that carries documents between campus offices, avoids people and temporary obstacles, and reports when it cannot safely continue.
Develop a monitoring system that uses electrical output and weather readings to identify underperforming rooftop solar panels and prioritize inspection.
Create an affordable field device that combines soil moisture and local weather measurements to recommend when a small farm plot should be irrigated.
Design an edge-based intersection monitor that estimates pedestrian waiting and crossing activity without storing identifiable video, to help evaluate signal timing.
Build a software platform that combines electricity meter readings from campus buildings, detects unusual consumption, and gives facility teams understandable comparisons over time.
Develop a portable temperature logger that warns clinic staff when a medicine storage refrigerator has been outside its safe temperature range for too long.
Create a campus bus information tool that estimates arrival times and approximate crowding from vehicle location updates while working on low-end phones.
Explore a classroom communication aid that recognizes a limited, clearly defined set of sign-language gestures and provides captions without claiming general translation.
Build a tool that discovers and inventories authorized embedded devices on a research lab network, records their firmware versions, and highlights devices needing updates.
Prototype a low-cost river monitoring station that measures pH, turbidity, and temperature and detects sensor drift before sending questionable readings to a dashboard.
